configuration.state: fresh disposable runner account; default native window and terminal
configuration.socket_policy: allowAll on the private CI socket, explicitly permitting the external benchmark driver
configuration.startup_boundary: LaunchServices open invocation to first observed completed terminal command; includes CLI startup and polling
configuration.echo_boundary: CLI send invocation to completion marker returned by CLI read-screen; includes both CLI launches and polling; NOT PTY-byte echo or input-to-pixel
